content:
It's time to take a look at the best new cases for the iPhone 18 Pro. Apple's latest pre-orders officially kicked off this morning, and products from some of the most popular brands are ready to go. Apple has launched all-new silicone cases and TechWoven collections to match the device colours, and there are plenty of favourite third-party brands we've relied on for years. Among them are brand-new burgundy options with built-in stands, customisable models with extra grip, and some of the finest leather options on the market from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods. There are also plenty of great-value options from affordable brands like Spigen, starting from $14.

The best iPhone 18 Pro cases

Featured: ESR

ESR's brand-new collection of iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories has arrived, featuring premium and colour-matched tremens, patented technology, and more. Leading the lineup is the latest Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with a built-in zinc-alloy Flex stand, combined with camera platform protection, offering 3x military-grade protection, along with a "soft and flexible feel that's more comfortable to hold." This new Atelier, like other accessories in the lineup, comes in four colour-matched options to perfectly complement the new Burgundy, Glacier, Black and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet Stand (with grip) $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad can be considered one of the industry's top brands for leather cases, and all of its flagship models are now available in iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max versions. This year also sees the launch of the all-new Rugged Case collection, with each colour featuring a topographic pattern of the Baja California Peninsula:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colours: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 to $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 to $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colour: Rustic Brown

Featured: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to go with its classic Grip case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. This case has a clean, sleek design with an ultra-grippy feel, is once again compatible with a wide range of customisable skins, and when bundled together, you can enjoy a discount on the compatible Prism screen protector.

  • Dbrand Grip Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $55 Customisable design, drop protection, ultra-grippy, excellent button feel
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) 2-pack $35 ($5 off when purchased with a case) Guaranteed easy install, auto-alignment, zero dust

This year, Dbrand will also be launching its all-new MNML brand cases, starting from $39, with minimal aesthetics, lower pricing, MagSafe compatibility, and the same beloved crisp button design as the main brand.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy, Tan, Burgundy

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case has arrived, and this year features brand-new colours to match Apple's Glacier and Burgundy devices:

  • Matte Black — $69.99
  • Polished Silver — $89.99
  • Polished Graphite — $99.99

  • Matte Deep Red — $119.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • iPhone 18 Series Full Leather Case $59
  • Colours: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Case $59
  • Removable magnetic backplate lets you freely switch between two modes. Panel attached: Full-grain leather case, slim and MagSafe compatible

Burton Goods

***Note: The cases below are eligible for an additional 20% off the already-discounted launch price with our exclusive code 9TO520. If that doesn't work, use DUO10 at checkout.

  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $60 (was $80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case (iPhone 18 Pro/Max) $89 (was $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case (iPhone 18 Duo) $60 (was $80)

UAG

UAG has also launched a range of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases, including its signature rugged series with reinforced corner protection, grippy frames, and multiple drop-proof designs. If you're looking for something tougher and more durable for everyday protection, UAG's lineup is definitely worth keeping an eye on.

  • UAG Mouve $65 For iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 For iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Grip Case from $60
  • And there's more…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you want a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with the usual options from OtterBox or UAG, check out YETI's LoadOut lineup. These cases are MIL-STD-810H drop-tested for reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating kickstand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you're looking for a more premium yet not overly bulky case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. Among them, the ultra-thin Aramid fibre case designed specifically for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max is available for pre-order starting today, along with the following selected models.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • And there's more…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases offer a more design-forward approach, featuring futuristic styling, an ultra-thin profile, and premium surface finishes that set them apart from typical cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-thin Aramid Fibre Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-proof Case $60 For iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

If you're looking for an even slimmer case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, PITAKA is a solid choice. The brand's cases typically use lightweight Aramid fibre with a clean, minimalist finish, while maintaining MagSafe compatibility and adding reinforced protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-grade Aramid Drop-proof Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protective Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also has a wide selection of iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max cases available, ranging from slim everyday options to tougher rugged choices to meet your needs for solid protection. Many of the newer models support MagSafe, and some styles also feature grippy textures, accessory holders, raised camera protection, and built-in kickstands, giving you the flexibility to choose based on the thickness and level of protection you need.

  • OtterBox Defender Pro Series $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Kickstand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And there's more…

Belkin

Belkin is also a reliable option for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, particularly suited for users who prefer a clean design and don't want a full rugged case. The brand's lineup includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges for the screen and camera, and some models (such as the Protect+) feature reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and a slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2-compatible MagSafe Case with Grip $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air-pocket Corners $60
